notes.title: Продолжение Almost My Floor
notes.content:
How real people become characters in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42705714/5d69e621c78ddc9b1bfeda011c5144836090b79e.jpg[/img]

After the trailer was released, many asked - whose voice is heard in the video? Today I will introduce you to the main voice actress of my game.

[previewyoutube=3WCm7r2bcuI;full][/previewyoutube]

Nastya is my teacher  in vocals, which I started studying from the beginning of the year. The project, by the way, was in deep freeze by that time. All my strength was spent on the main work with the publisher and on the fight with myself and the leaking roof. But you never know who, where and when will inspire you to great achievements. After just a couple of classes, the image of a new heroine was born in my head. The image of an unattainable star, mysterious and shining.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42705714/594dcb87d5994c5c21258ceabf498204f0520e6c.png[/img]

Contrast is one of the main tools of storytelling. I decided that the game needed a ray of light among all the hopelessness that I had created in my depressive mind. And I made music and my passion for it the main theme of the game. With her voice, the new heroine Victoria closes the rifts to other layers of the world. Music saves you from the oppressive reality and horrors around you. A separate game mechanic for keeping characters sane will be based on this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42705714/55aec96df84acd5bdee99ca1d6c4a44da81065a0.jpg[/img]

The trailer is just the beginning. Nastya's voice will sound as you play as Masha (yes, she doesn't voice herself, because the new character says too little). Will be cool! I already have candidates for the other main roles, but more on that later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42705714/ceb8a63b5d807472ed2e82769a002206d2b5856e.png[/img]

notes.title: New gameplay trailer is ready!
notes.content:
Lately I’ve been busy adding gameplay scenes to the game and clarifying my understanding of what kind of game I’m making and what mechanics I want to implement.

[previewyoutube=UUgRa0G3R1w;full][/previewyoutube]

Because I want to make my story as interactive as possible, I chose a few core mechanics that are also ways to get through certain situations.

Point&click: collecting and using objects, puzzles.

Action scenes: fighting monsters with the help of superpowers, quicktime scenes.

Stealth: you don’t have to go ahead, but bypass the danger. Distract opponents and take advantage of the environment.

Choice of events: in dialogues, in tactics of fighting monsters, in action scenes.

I’m already beginning to better understand what kind of game this Almost my floor: duality will be. There will be quite a lot of mechanics, you can fight monsters, fight them, run away, be smart and avoid dangerous situations. The main thing is I want to tell a story. the story of heroes who find themselves surrounded by fear at the worst moment of their lives. How will they cope? Depends on the player's decisions. Maybe they won't cope at all.

The heroes have superpowers that contribute to the choice of a certain passage option. But they are not obliged to do so.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/ceb8a63b5d807472ed2e82769a002206d2b5856e.png[/img]

All images are based on the author's real fears and nightmares. Even the initial idea of ​​the elevator taking you somewhere to an impossible floor number is one of my frequent nightmares.

Feel free to add it to your wishlist if you haven't already (and it's highly recommended). This adds a lot of motivation for me as a developer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/4ca9ec5c560a85a8b02fade91c12996384e0b9bd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog 12 - Main character concepts
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
First of all, I want to say thank you for your support! We are very glad that the gaming community reacted positively to our game! This is very important for us and inspires us to make even more cool games!

This time I want to share with you the old concepts of the main character Alex. Many people know from our last game Potata that we often change the concept of the main character during development. The main character of the game "Potata: Fairy Flower" had more than 8 versions. This time we pulled ourselves together and reduced this number to only 3.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/131b6c2b955050757f297a1d576273b8a8539b54.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/131b6c2b955050757f297a1d576273b8a8539b54.jpg[/img][/url]
The picture is a large size, you can enlarge it and study the past versions of the character in more detail.

The first one looked too funny against the rest of the characters, which looked the same as now in the main game. The second was replaced by the third because we wanted to make him a more serious look. This time only the faces were changed, not the main body, so we did not change animations for all of them.

Which one do you like more?

notes.title: Devlog 09 - changes in exploration system
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! We didn't about our progress for a long time, and I think the moment has come. We thought a lot about our exploration system and decided to slightly change it.

Previously, when you click on any active object in a location, a selection window always appeared and you had to click on one of the options. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/745dcb12be39ad189f5c665c546aea65f8548b8c.png[/img]

If this is an item, then examine it or take it. If a person - then examine or talk. We thought that many items cannot be taken and the hero often just says a standard reply, or something superfluous.
Fun fact - in the early stages there were always 3 options at one time.

And now we've added objects that can only be inspected or only taken and they will have special icons on the cursor. Thus, the player will poke fewer times and examine the location faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/aa4ab16a2040faaa41675dc34c9e9a2e9e468946.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/4619cbbf3e1ab355cf45e9a982232f750ef2c028.png[/img]

Don't worry, the option with simultaneous inspection and taking is still there. For items like that cursor now slightly changed, it has a question mark inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/a38aba081c7372a150aac6e42457a703be3ee3f5.png[/img][/h3]

notes.title: Almost My Floor: – Developer Live Stream
notes.content:
[b]Watch our live stream![/b]
Join us at the Summer Game Festival as we're playing through the Almost My Floor and answering the Community questions live!

[b]About the game:[/b]
Almost my Floor - It is a mix of point'n'click adventure, horror, and mystery which you can influence with your decisions. Vivid comic book art style will help you experience the creepy world around you, and maybe a little bit of humor too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/613ef8285f9e8fa5318c29b0d03a18c7c3f694df.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The release date postponed to August 2021
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! The world of the game is getting bigger compared to the original plans, new heroes, new places and plot twists appear. We have to admit that we need more time to fine-tune the game, so we have to postpone the release of the game until August 2021 in order to give our best, put into the game everything we want, and polish it.

Here are some interesting new locations that weren't on the original plans. [/h3]

notes.title: Devlog 06 - Prologue is coming on 5 October 2020!
notes.content:
[h2]Good news, everyone! The prologue is coming pretty soon (5 October 2020) and we are so excited to hear your feedback![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395230/Almost_My_Floor_Prologue/

[h3]So what we did last month? Of course, we've spent a lot of time to polish the game in the first locations, where are placed the prologue. And a lot of bugfixes. It was so uncomfortable to see videos on youtube when players meet critical bugs and can't go any further... my god, it was horrible... but worries not, we've fixed everything that was mentioned and the game is ready for mass players =)

Let me show you something to make you more excited about the game =)

The main news, we've made a solution to add comics to our game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/325d347bca46e6086e6a7a46bd08d735b6afba42.png[/img]
Pretty awesome, right?

There are a lot of places when need to make a solution and now you have little helpers: angel and demon. They help you make the right choice and comment on your actions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/3d26a9d396a1f00b94a559e6c17c0b3f174ce1d6.png[/img][/h3]

notes.title: Devlog 02 - life after demoversion
notes.content:
After demoversion release we working hard on content for main game. Demo is just a prologue of the main story. Now we adding character to game world, working on story, adding horror elements to gameplay.

One of the characters is this cute spider-bitey. I will not spoiler details how you will meet, but it not easy to take care of him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/806ca365706b565cb48cfa03d58a50ad0eb21d36.gif[/img]

Did you remember blue goblin from trailer?

We've added emotional images in dialogs for her. Btw, there is multiple endings and walkthrough in our game. Ending depends on how you will handle all problems and way of interactions with characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/69c2204d2a87c632f7009bc348aef8dd8c386a29.jpg[/img]

On every floor will waiting a boss!.... Puzzle-boss!

To avoid spoilers we'll not show puzzles itself. The main thing is that we added the ability to skip them. There still a way to complete the game, eve if not enough savvy. But the question is - will the story have good end in this case?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/b4ef3b08ba9f4a84a7c7f8e79cd0a47fa5ef4894.jpg[/img]

It's hard to share content ad not reveal game story. But still we'll try to show you something interesting! Work is in full swing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/d9fcda87b4893b75b9020dbc0e02715ab6ebef1d.png[/img]
